column1: # G0: can fine slices be reconstructed cleanly, and does our pipeline reproduce Lei & Wang's single atom?
# G0a  the campaign's S1 kernel (one-plane Pb grid, ARM aberrations known), 0.25 A simulation slices, standard
#      27.525 A box, four slice counts: dz 1.53 / 0.98 / 0.74 / 0.50 A. NL 18 is also the link to the campaign kernels
#      (same recon, but simulated with 0.9 A slices).
# G0b  Lei & Wang's single-atom test (arXiv 2506.22352 SI Note 5: one atom in vacuum, aberration-free probe, 4 nm box;
#      their 80 mrad FWHM is 2.8 A): one Pb atom, ideal probe at their crystal-run defocus (-0.7 nm, ~1 A probe) so a
#      0.25 A step over 10 A overlaps well at the campaign's per-iteration cost (they used defocus 0 and a 160 x 160
#      scan), 40 A box, dz 1.0 and 0.5 A.
